job.question: What questions does the INREV DDQ 2022 for Funds of Funds and Multi Manager ask under section 3.3 'IT, Cyber and Physical Security'?
job.expected_facts: Fourteen questions (3.3.1-3.3.14): (1) position, responsibilities and members of the IT function, and an overview of outsourced IT and how vendors are monitored; (2) compliance with ISO 27001 or other cyber/information security certifications; (3) whether IT and physical security is a standing board agenda item; (4) a formal, documented Cyber Incident Response Plan; (5) any material cyber/information security incident in the past three years; (6) approved antivirus on all servers, workstations and remote devices; (7) how often staff get IT security training; (8) phishing/social engineering tests on staff; (9) how often full (physical and system) vulnerability assessments are done; (10) how often internal and external penetration tests are done; (11) critical/high-risk findings outstanding for over six months; (12) an external cyber security specialist engaged as first point of contact; (13) how physical access to the server/communication room is controlled; (14) a policy on physical access outside standard office hours, e.g. whether permanent staff are on the premises when third-party suppliers work.
job.acceptance: All fourteen topics may be grouped in prose. Preserve three-year incident lookback and six-month outstanding high-risk findings; no need to reproduce every question verbatim.

reviews.reason: The document is the 2018 DDQ for Non-Listed Real Estate Investment Vehicles, not the 2022 Funds of Funds and Multi Manager DDQ. Its section 3.3 overlaps with many requested topics but contains only 13 questions; it does not include the IT-function and outsourced-vendor question or the broader after-hours physical-access policy question.
quotes: As the non-listed real estate market has evolved, the questionnaire has been regularly updated – in 2010, 2014 and most recently in 2018.
INREV will enhance its separate due diligence questionnaires for fund of funds and multi-manager mandates as well as real estate debt vehicles.
3.3 IT, Cyber and Physical Security 3.3.1 Are you compliant with ISO 27001 or any other cyber security or information security certifications?
3.3.4 Have you experienced any material internal or external information/cyber security incident in the past three years?
3.3.10 Are there any critical or high-risk points from any penetration tests or vulnerability assessments that are currently outstanding and have been so for over six months?
3.3.13 Are permanent members of staff always on the premises when the cleaners are working?
